policy: The Android app of the current release and of the three releases published before it. docs/ANDROID_COMPATIBILITY.md explains the fields; scripts/android-support-window.mts checks them.

emulators.why: reported crash on a Pixel with Android 17 (0.21.3)

handshake.note: Every shell in the window checks that GET /api/version answers app = "unihub". Shells from 0.22.1 also read features: they offer notifications only while they list android-notifications. None reads protocol or minApp yet, so the server must keep app = "unihub", keep listing android-notifications while a shell in the window uses it, and must not raise minApp above the oldest shell here.
